QUEUE.ERROR: Could not complete the action. Please try again.

TRANSFER.TITLE: Transfer conversation
TRANSFER.DESCRIPTION: Choose the team, the agent or both. The note is kept as a private note.
TRANSFER.NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. the customer wants to talk about the yearly plan
TRANSFER.ERROR: Could not transfer the conversation. Please try again.

CLOSING.TITLE: Close conversation
CLOSING.DESCRIPTION: Choose why this conversation is being closed.
CLOSING.BULK_DESCRIPTION: Choose why these {count} conversations are being closed. The reason applies to all of them.
CLOSING.NO_REASONS: There is no active closing reason, so conversations cannot be closed. Ask an administrator to add one in Settings → Closing reasons.
CLOSING.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the closing reasons. Try again.
CLOSING.ERROR: Could not close the conversation. Try again.

CLOSING_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: Every conversation closed by a person needs a reason. Reasons without teams are available to everyone.
CLOSING_REASONS.EMPTY: There are no closing reasons yet. Without one, nobody can close a conversation.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete closing reason
DELETE_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: Delete "{name}"? A reason already used cannot be deleted, only deactivated.

DIALOG.NAME: Name
DIALOG.CLOSING_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Sent to the customer when the conversation is closed with this reason

START_CONVERSATION.TITLE: Start conversation
START_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: Start a new conversation with a contact
START_CONVERSATION.SEARCH_HINT: Type at least two letters to find the contact.
START_CONVERSATION.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_HINT: On the official WhatsApp, the first message must be a template approved by Meta.
START_CONVERSATION.ERROR: Could not start the conversation. Try again.
START_CONVERSATION.NO_INBOX: There is no inbox to reach this contact. Use a number with an inbox that sends by phone, such as WhatsApp.
